_README: Accession-exact vendor coverage gaps at a CIK cutover (decision P24): one row per Sharadar quarter missing from the canonical series while the SEC filing that reports it is present.
A missing quarter with no row here fails the continuity gate; a row whose quarter is present again (healed) fails too and must be deleted.

Read through src/utils/cutover_continuity.py by `validate identity`. The vendor series is judged as merged: a quarter the predecessor's own vendor series (BHI, STE1, ...) fills inside its register window heals its row, which must then be deleted.

exceptions.label: Sharadar/source coverage gap; SEC filings present
